$comment: A workflow is data: steps in, assertions out.
Note there is no 'sleep' action and never should be. A fixed delay is a bet
that CI is at least as fast as your laptop, and CI loses that bet. Every
wait here is for a condition the page can actually reach.
Every workflow MUST contain at least one assert_* step. A run where every
selector matched nothing and nothing was asserted otherwise reports success.
name: search
description: Search the fixture site and verify results render asynchronously
